findings.title: Oversized bed_id makes watering endpoints return 500
findings.steps: Signed in, POST {"bed_id":9223372036854775808} (or 99999999999999999999) to /api/waterings; also GET /api/waterings?bed_id=9223372036854775808 and DELETE /api/waterings/9223372036854775808
findings.expected: 4xx validation error (no upper bound is set on the ints)
findings.evidence: curl got 'Internal Server Error [500]' for all three. Opening /waterings?bed=99999999999999999999 shows only 'Could not load waterings.'

findings.title: Non-finite litres (1e400 / NaN) make POST /api/waterings return 500
findings.evidence: curl: 'Internal Server Error [500]' for both payloads

findings.title: No retry on the watering error states (dashboard and waterings page)
findings.steps: Make GET /api/waterings fail (server down or bad query, e.g. /waterings?bed=abc), then open the dashboard or /waterings
findings.expected: Error message with a Retry button that loads again without a page reload
findings.actual: Only an AlertMessage is shown. The dashboard never destructures refresh for waterings and the waterings page offers no retry. Changing the filter is the only way to refetch.
findings.evidence: SSR of /waterings?bed=abc shows the error text and no retry control. index.vue: `const { data: waterings, error: wateringsError } = wateringsResult`, with no refresh

findings.title: Failed bed list on the waterings page is silent; filter shows only 'All beds'
findings.steps: Make GET /api/beds fail while GET /api/waterings succeeds, then open /waterings
findings.expected: An error saying beds could not be loaded, with a retry
findings.actual: bedsResult.error is ignored. The Bed select just has 'All beds', as if the garden had no beds, so the filter by bed can't be used
findings.evidence: waterings.vue: `const { data: beds } = bedsResult`, and the error is never rendered

findings.title: Water now / Save watering have no timeout and no duplicate protection on retry
findings.where: /beds Water now and Record past watering; POST /api/waterings
findings.steps: Click Water now while the API is slow or hangs. Wait, then click again once it fails or re-enables
findings.expected: Request fails after 10 s with a visible error, and a retry after a timeout leaves only one watering
findings.actual: The $fetch client sets no timeout, so the button can stay 'Watering…'/'Saving…' indefinitely. POST has no idempotency key, so a retry after a timed-out-but-applied request records a second watering
findings.evidence: useApiClient() sets no timeout. recordWatering sends a plain POST. Each POST creates a new row (API returned new ids 4, 5, 6 for repeated posts)

findings.title: Tiny litre amounts are accepted but displayed as '0 L'
findings.steps: Record a past watering with litres 0.001 (the form uses novalidate and only checks > 0). The API also accepts 1e-7
findings.expected: Reject amounts below the 0.1 step/min, or show the actual value
findings.actual: Saved, and formatLitres (maximumFractionDigits 2) shows '0 L' in the notice and lists
findings.evidence: POST litres 0.0000001 returned 201 with litres 1e-7. formatLitres rounds to 2 decimals

findings.title: Absurd past dates such as year 0001 are accepted
findings.expected: Refuse implausible dates with a reason (there is only an upper bound)
findings.actual: 201 Created, and it shows in the log as 1 Jan 1
findings.evidence: API returned id 3 with watered_on 0001-01-01 (deleted afterwards)

findings.title: Bed filter does not follow URL changes within the waterings page
findings.steps: Open /waterings?bed=1, then click the 'Waterings' nav link (route becomes /waterings), or use browser back/forward between filter values
findings.expected: List and select match the URL
findings.actual: bedFilter is read from route.query only once at setup, so the list stays filtered to the old bed while the URL says all beds
findings.evidence: waterings.vue: ref initialised from route.query.bed. A watch syncs filter→URL but nothing syncs URL→filter

findings.title: Raw validation text shown for an invalid ?bed= value and the select goes blank
findings.expected: Ignore the bad filter or show a friendly message
findings.actual: Shows 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer'. The select has no matching option, and there's no retry
findings.evidence: SSR HTML of /waterings?bed=abc contains that text

findings.title: Long unbroken bed names can overflow the watering tables at 375 px
findings.steps: Create a bed with a 60-character name without spaces, water it, and view /waterings at 375 px wide
findings.expected: Text wraps and there is no sideways scroll
findings.actual: The .table cells have no overflow-wrap/word-break and the table has no scroll wrapper. The 4-column table (date+time, bed, amount, Delete) is likely wider than the viewport
findings.evidence: main.css .table rules have no wrapping. There is no overflow-wrap anywhere in the stylesheet
